basic_info.description: Swanky, Bright, Top Floor Condo w views of Dolores Heights & Sutro Tower! 2 BD + 1.5 BA Edwardian. East, west & some southern exposure. Formal, spacious & bright BDs, formal living & dining + flex space for office/laundry. Period details, yet updates throughout. Modern kitchen w new appliances. Walk-in pantry. Decorative fireplaces. Refinished HDWD floors. In-unit laundry. 1 car private garage. Shared deck with views, common area patio/bike storage. Access to transit, plethora of dining, the best of SF!
